what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Bangladesh in Italy: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 37128 Bangladeshi asylum seekers in Italy, 40.2% of all asylum seekers from Bangladesh.
Refugees from Bangladesh, a separate group, live mostly in France, Canada, the United Kingdom and the United States.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Bangladesh with the PBCP and PBCP-J in 2005 and 2006, and with the Islamic State group in 2016 and 2017.
The fact pack does not link these conflicts to the asylum figures.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2010 at 122 asylum seekers.
The figure reached its highest point, 41127, at the end of 2024, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2023 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Italy.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Italy only.
